title: Lyme disease cases: officially reported vs. CDC's real estimate

source.name: Lyme Disease Surveillance and Data
source.publisher: U.S. Centers for Disease Control and Prevention (CDC)

notes: The CDC's National Notifiable Diseases Surveillance System receives roughly 20,000-30,000 confirmed/probable Lyme reports a year, but the agency's own claims-based estimate of people actually treated for Lyme disease annually is about 476,000 -- a figure the CDC itself has publicized as the more realistic burden.
